title: Counting sunflowers with restricted matching number
summary: For $\mathcal H\subseteq\binom{[n]}k$, let $ν(\mathcal H)$ denote its matching number and let $d_{\mathcal H}(E)$ denote the codegree of a $(k-1)$-set $E$. We study the codegree moments $ co_p(\mathcal H)=\sum_{E\in\binom{[n]}{k-1}}d_{\mathcal H}(E)^p $ and the number of copies of the $k$-uniform $l$-petal sunflower $S_{k,l}^{k-1}$ whose core has size $k-1$.
